name: ModelVariant81_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant81_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a ribbon of gradient quads twists from a model part towards a point in front of the opposing slot, one segment longer every two frames.  Four textured cylinders then open around the opposing slot one after another, sweeping their quads in while they turn, and finally grow and fade out; at the end the opposing slot's tint target is reset); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-98 images build the same source directly in both slots, at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
